t: What Cosmological Model Comparison Database Is All About
title: What Cosmological Model Comparison Database Is All About
description: Cosmology tests universe models against sky data: the Lambda-CDM model (Big Bang + dark matter + dark energy) fits the cosmic microwave background exquisitely but faces the Hubble tension — early-universe data says H0 ≈ 67 km/s/Mpc, late-universe says ≈ 73. The CMB is 2.725 K everywhere; its tiny fluctuations (1 part in 100,000) seeded all galaxies. Every model here is scored on predictions vs observations. This database is the complete cosmological model: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
